content_feed.headline: Servotech launches hybrid solar and micro‑grid inverters for domestic and export markets
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Launch of new inverter products expands portfolio and opens export markets
content_feed.telegram_post: 🚀 #NEW_PRODUCT | INSTITUTIONAL NOTE 🏢 Servotech Renewable Power System Limited (NSE: SERVOTECH) Servotech launches hybrid solar and micro‑grid inverters for domestic and export markets ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 The Event: ↳ Servotech Renewable Power System Ltd announced the launch of hybrid solar inverters (IP65 & IP54) and micro‑grid inverters on 27 September 2026. The products are positioned for both domestic sales and export to SAARC countries and the Middle East. 📊 Key Operational Metrics: • Scale / Size: Introduction of two inverter product lines – hybrid solar and micro‑grid. • Operational Scope: Serves domestic market and exports to SAARC and Middle East regions. • Strategic Rationale: Expands product portfolio in renewable energy, targeting growing demand for off‑grid solutions. 🎯 Analyst Watchlist: ↳ Track initial order book and export traction in the next fiscal quarter. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: Madhya Bharat Agro Products Ltd starts commercial production of 300 TPD phosphoric acid plant
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Commencement of commercial production adds significant capacity and alters operational outlook
content_feed.telegram_post: 🏭 #COMMERCIAL_PRODUCTION | INSTITUTIONAL NOTE 🏢 Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited (NSE: MBAPL) Madhya Bharat Agro Products Ltd starts commercial production of 300 TPD phosphoric acid plant ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 The Event: ↳ Madhya Bharat Agro Products Ltd has begun commercial operations at its 300 tonnes‑per‑day phosphoric acid (PA) plant in Dhule, Maharashtra. The commencement was announced on 28 September 2026. 📊 Key Operational Metrics: • Scale / Size: 300 TPD phosphoric acid production capacity. • Operational Scope: Dhule, Maharashtra plant targeting fertilizer industry. • Strategic Rationale: Adds significant production capacity, enhancing revenue potential and market presence. 🎯 Analyst Watchlist: ↳ Monitor ramp‑up of plant utilisation and impact on sales in upcoming quarters. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
